title.narrative: Provision of Life-saving Cholera supplies to 263,742 people in six high-priority and Cholera affected districts in Malawi and enhanced outbreak detection and response.

description.narrative: This WHO project supports the delivery of time-critical, life-saving health services to people affected by Cholera in six high-priority districts. WHO’s health interventions focus on the procurement and distribution of medical supplies besides, the deployment of rapid response teams. This allocation Ensures the availability of essential Cholera supplies and Consequently addresses immediate health risks among people at risk of Cholera reducing morbidity and mortality. The project provides humanitarian assistance to 263,742 people, including 67,201 women, 62,033 men, 134,508 children, and including 29,010 persons with disabilities.
